info.title: HELIOS API v1 — people and read API
info.description: First read slice; legacy write APIs retain known project authorization limitations. All protected routes require active tenant membership. Directors see their tenant, master/PTO need active project membership, workers additionally need own active employee assignment for projects/tasks. Own employee profile may be read without assignment. Details hide inaccessible rows with 404. Counts use authorized rows. Overview uses civil day in tenant timezone with half-open timestamp bounds. reviewedReportsForDay means accepted_quantity IS NOT NULL, including zero, not completed tasks. currentOpenShifts is current across days. Null acceptedQuantity means no report in the group has been reviewed. No mixed-unit sum. Unavailable metrics are intentional capability declarations. Phase02a adds director-only people commands with durable requestId replay, expectedVersion, immutable yes/no admission evidence, project assignments and crews. Document references are metadata only. Current admission requires latest attempt/template and exact active qualification id/version, inclusive tenant civil-date expiry. Legacy task/sync writes still bypass this new admission workflow; task readiness is phase02b.
